title: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure initiation

entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to disconnect from a PDN by sending a PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message, starting timer T3492, and entering PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request PDN disconnection. Contains the linked EPS bearer identity of the default bearer associated with the PDN.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network in response to PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST, leading to bearer deactivation.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to reject the PDN disconnection request.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Information element included in PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message identifying the default bearer associated with the PDN to disconnect from.

entities.name: T3492
entities.description: Timer started by the UE when initiating PDN disconnection procedure and stopped upon receiving network response.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State entered by the UE after sending PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST and starting T3492.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message.
The procedure requires entering PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.
PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message contains linked EPS bearer identity IE.
DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message stops timer T3492.
PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message stops timer T3492.
